_comment: Destination photography, one entry per location id in js/data.js. Generated by tools/fetch_commons.py — see images/README.md for the shape. Every entry carries the credit its licence requires and the app renders it; an entry without a complete credit is a licence breach, so the tool refuses to write one. The Portree entry is the owner's own photograph, already in this repository, seeded by hand because its caption names the place with certainty. The other owner photographs say only "Highland glen" or "Falls and pool", so mapping them to a location would be a guess and they are left out until the owner says where they were taken.
